root_cause: Race condition in inventory decrement logic. The inventory fetch operation is asynchronous but the decrement operation does not await the result, causing undefined access when the inventory object is not yet resolved. This occurs during high-concurrency checkout scenarios.

suspect_files.reason: Async inventory fetch not awaited before accessing quantity property
processCheckout function calls decrementInventory without proper error handling
